items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: And so me, Felix King and all them big gamblers, we always at the counter drinking liquor.

ctx.x: And the ladies hats are still beautiful there, they say. Yeah.

At 25's was a great place there. Now I hit Amorphedi one time in 25, yeah. Amorphedi, he, he got, I don't know, I was, I was dressed nice and all the time, you know. And so me, Felix King and all them big gamblers, we always at the counter drinking liquor. Well I, W, Hartford then time was, you could get a whole fifth or down the quarter. I, W, oh, good boy even whiskey. So this old Norfolk and I come in there and he, he, he was watching me, and I didn't know it, but I was playing pool, cause I had the queues, 20…
I hit him with a cue stick. Well.
